title: Amazon Has 'Very Comfortable' Skechers Slip-In Sneakers on Sale for Over 60% Off - NewsBreak
text: Parade aims to feature only the best products and services. If you buy something via one of our links, we may earn a commission. Whether you need new shoes for working out, going on walks, or just running errands around town, you can never go wrong with Skechers. And right now, you can score one of the brand's top-rated slip-in styles, the Glide Step Tranquility Sneakers , for 65% off on Amazon. Originally $98, the popular sneakers are now on sale for as low as $34. They're available in three colorways — black, blue, and white — and sizes 5 to 12 (including half sizes) at varying prices. The shoes feature an air-cooled memory foam cushioned insole that provides a soft and supportive feel right out of the box. A flexible outsole offers enhanced traction, allowing the shoes to maintain grip even in slippery conditions or on rough terrain. Skechers' signature heel pillow helps hold your foot in place, while the breathable upper keeps you cool and comfortable. Thanks to the slip-in design, these "cute" and "comfortable" sneakers are also super easy to take on and off. "Bought these for my mother-in-law, who has trouble putting on shoes that tie but needs good support. She just has to slip her foot in," one shopper wrote. "She loves them. She says they look great and they’re comfortable to wear to work all day." Related: New Balance Has the ‘Most Comfortable Walking Shoes' on Sale for Just $55 Reviewers also praised the shoes' ultra-cushioned feel and "perfect fit." One buyer said, "These are so comfy. I can walk all day in these and never notice my feet. The step-in really works too. What a time saver! These are made really well and feel durable." With their comfy fit and versatile look, these Skechers slip-ins will upgrade any wardrobe. Snag a pair while they're still 65% off on Amazon.
